# Examples (all inputs are fictional; all outputs are real output of `scripts/cl.py`, regenerated by `dev/make_examples.py`)

These are **examples of the interface, not results of any evaluation case**. Authors, journals and DOIs (prefix 10.9999, unregistered) are invented.

| folder | input | what it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `md/` | `manuscript.md` (numeric markers out of order, one uncited entry, two unresolved markers, a range written `[3, 4, 5, 6]`), `library.bib` + `library.ris` (the same article in both, one preprint version in the list), `decisions.txt` | `run.txt`: the one-shot `run` (audit, dedupe with rule and year conflict, claim sentences without a source, structure check, first build with the unresolved markers still visible and `status: partial`), then `ingest decisions.txt` and `build` (one citation inserted, one unresolved marker replaced, one dropped; renumbered by first appearance; `out/changes.md`, `out/numbering_map.csv`, `out/review_checklist.md`, `out/result.json`) |
| `tex/` | `paper.tex` + `library.bib` | `\cite` / `\citep`, unresolved key replaced, claim marker inserted with `after:`, a `partial` judgement recorded for a 10% vs 9% mismatch, `\bibliography` pointed at the generated `references.bib` |
| `apa/` | `manuscript.md` with author-year markers and an unnumbered APA list | markers kept, list rebuilt and sorted, an unresolved author-year marker left untouched and reported |
| `zh/` | `manuscript_spec.txt` (text spec of a Chinese Word file: superscript markers, GB/T 7714 list) | the `.docx` is built by `dev/make_docx.py`; `out/manuscript.txt` shows the rewritten text with `^{n}` marking superscript runs, `out/references.gbt7714.txt` the regenerated list |

Reproduce one: `python3 scripts/cl.py run examples/md/manuscript.md --lib examples/md/library.bib --lib examples/md/library.ris --out /tmp/out`.
